note: loginOrRegister(true): v10_login.c's Register card against the same markup in Chromium with v10's CSS (tools/uidiff/v10_login_ref.py). Chromium's popup is 6 px taller (the sign-up bonuses wrap, see that region), so the regions above it read the reference 3 px higher and those below 3 px lower. The input fields are left out (focus ring / caret). The text regions differ by glyph rasterisation (FreeType vs Skia, 1 px advances); a text-sized button would differ by far more
